fact: An ANPFI expert stated on 20 October 2026 that Burkina Faso's overall financial inclusion rate was 79.7% at the end of 2024, with half of those included through e-money and half of those e-money accounts inactive.
title: Inclusion financière : avec 79,7 % à fin 2024, le Burkina en avance de 6,1 points sur le taux global de l'UEMOA
